definitions.gloss: atmospheric pressure; air pressure; barometric pressure
definitions.explanation: The pressure exerted by the weight of the atmosphere. Used in weather forecasts and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {低|てい}{気圧|きあつ}が{近|ちか}づいている。
{山頂|さんちょう}では{気圧|きあつ}が{低|ひく}い。
examples.english: Atmospheric pressure is low at the mountaintop.

examples.japanese: {気圧|きあつ}の{変化|へんか}で{頭痛|ずつう}がする。
examples.english: I get headaches from changes in air pressure.
examples.notes: [Note: Weather-related headaches are common in Japan]

notes:
WEATHER:
・{高|こう}{気圧|きあつ} (high pressure system - brings clear weather)
・{低|てい}{気圧|きあつ} (low pressure system - brings clouds/rain)
・{気圧|きあつ}の{谷|たに} (pressure trough)
・{気圧|きあつ}の{変化|へんか} (pressure change)

UNITS:
・hPa (ヘクトパスカル) - standard unit
・1気圧 = 1013.25 hPa (standard atmospheric pressure)

HEALTH:
・{気圧|きあつ}の{変化|へんか}で{頭痛|ずつう} (weather-related headaches)
・{気象病|きしょうびょう} (meteoropathy - illness affected by weather)

SCIENCE:
・{大気圧|たいきあつ} (atmospheric pressure - formal)
・{気圧計|きあつけい} (barometer)
